responsibility: Implements the Rust frontend helper that classifies source filenames for Rust module directory ownership rules. This file provides get_file_subdir, which distinguishes special module roots such as mod.rs, lib.rs, and main.rs from ordinary *.rs files and derives the subdirectory name owned by a non-root module file, supporting crate/module loading logic that must resolve Rust’s file-versus-directory module layout conventions.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the rust-dir-owner pair: it contains the executable get_file_subdir logic that checks special root filenames like mod.rs/lib.rs/main.rs and strips the .rs suffix for ordinary module files, whereas rust-dir-owner.h only declares that helper interface.
